result.summary: Found one clear visual/content defect: an untranslated localization key is displayed as a section heading. Excluded items per instructions include edge-clipped carousel items and bottom viewport cutoff.

issues.description: A section heading shows the raw string "home_feed.popular_title" instead of localized user-facing text.
issues.suggestion: Replace the placeholder key with the proper localized title for the current locale, and add a fallback so missing translations never render as keys.
